shortDescription: Some investors are buying into the world’s biggest bond market despite the recent rout, drawn by income and the chance to lock in 5% yields, according to Bloomberg.For all the anxiety gripping the market, the appeal of higher income has emerged as a reason to step in.

title: Bond Selloff Draws Investors Seeking 5% Yields
